name: Dash Weather
description: Hourly, today, radar loop, 5-day, plus UV, tides, sun, moon and air quality. Uses your phone's location.

data.label: Units
data.description: Imperial is F, mph, miles and feet. Metric is C, km/h, kilometers and meters.

data.label: Location
data.description: Auto follows your phone's GPS. Manual always uses the coordinates below.

data.label: Fixed latitude
data.description: Used only when Location is Fixed place. Example: 40.7128

data.label: Fixed longitude
data.description: Used only when Location is Fixed place. Example: -74.0060

data.label: Tide station (optional)
data.description: Leave empty to use the nearest NOAA station. Or enter a station number, such as 8518750.

data.label: Map tile address (advanced)
data.description: Leave empty for OpenStreetMap. To use another provider, paste its https address containing {z}, {x} and {y}.

data.label: Darken map tiles
data.description: Turns the light OpenStreetMap look into a dark one. Turn off if your own tile address is already dark.

data.label: Reverse the dial
data.description: Turn this on if the dial goes the wrong way. It flips the screens, the map zoom and the hour scrubbing together.

data.label: Dim at night
data.description: Lowers the screen light after sunset and puts it back at sunrise, for the place on screen. The moon button on the screen wins until the sun next rises or sets. Off by default.

data.label: Animate radar
data.description: Plays the last hour of radar as a loop on the Map screen. Turn off to show only the latest picture and fetch less.

data.label: Standby screen
data.description: After a quiet spell the screen swaps to plain white on black with the temperature and chance of rain, and the screen light goes down. Any button, dial turn or touch wakes it. Off by default.

data.label: Standby starts after
data.description: How long with no button, dial or touch before standby starts.

data.label: Clock on standby
data.description: Shows a small clock in the corner of the standby screen. It follows the 12-hour or 24-hour setting above. Off by default.

data.label: Second place name
data.description: Shown at the top of Hourly when the pin button switches to the second place. Example: Boston, MA

data.label: Second place latitude
data.description: The pin button appears once both coordinates are set. Example: 42.3601
